dispositionBoard.title: Disposition Board
dispositionBoard.attentionFlagsRemaining: As few as {count} more attention flags until disposition
dispositionBoard.estimatedDaysUntilDisposition: Estimated ~{days} trading days until disposition ({count} more attention flags)
dispositionBoard.projectionCaveat: Both the flag-count and day estimates are this site's own rule-based projection — accumulating {flags} attention flags within a rolling {window}-trading-day window is treated as entering disposition; the day estimate further extrapolates from this stock's own observed flag rate, an estimate on top of an estimate, not an official TWSE-published figure, and bounded by however much attention-flag history has accumulated since this feature launched.

factorCaption.momentum: 12-1 momentum (trailing 12-month return excluding the most recent month), ranked against the day's universe
factorCaption.trend_quality: Share of Minervini trend-template conditions met
factorCaption.value_guard: Composite of EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, P/E, P/B, mapped to a 0-100 cross-sectional standing
factorCaption.quality: Composite of ROE, debt/equity, earnings variability, ROIC, gross profitability, mapped to a 0-100 cross-sectional standing
factorCaption.revenue_flow: Institutional 20-day net-buy trend percentile (monthly-revenue YoY sub-signal not yet ingested)
factorCaption.premium_discount: Deviation from NAV (TWSE's own estimated figure), scored on a fixed-deviation scale — closer to par scores higher, never ranked against other ETFs
factorCaption.cost: Expense ratio ranked low-to-high against today's whole ETF universe — lower cost scores higher
factorCaption.management_activity: Holdings-turnover percentile against today's active-management ETF universe — active ETFs only
